reader_summary.headline: My guest this week is Marissa King, a professor of organizational behavior at the Yale School of Management.
reader_summary.overview: My guest this week is Marissa King, a professor of organizational behavior at the Yale School of Management. I was fascinated by Marissa's work after coming across her book, Social Chemistry: Decoding the Elements of Human Connection, earlier this year. Our conversation covers the three types of social networking styles, the surprising impact of COVID on social networks.

key_points.text: Our conversation covers the three types of social networking styles, the surprising impact of COVID on social networks.
This episode covers many topics I haven't explored before that I find fascinating.
I hope you enjoy my conversation with Marissa King.
